words.meaning: 負擔得起的成本；可承受的費用
words.note: 使用者提供的表達。意思清楚，但在一般消費者語境中 affordable price 通常比 affordable cost 更自然；affordable cost 較適合談整體費用或成本負擔。

exercises.original: The clinic was designed to provide basic care at a low price that ordinary families could manage.
exercises.zh: 診所的設計目標是以一般家庭能承擔的低費用提供基本照護。
exercises.upgrade: affordable cost · 負擔得起的成本；可承受的費用

options.explanation: ordinary families could manage 強調整體費用的可負擔性；服務語境中 affordable cost 可成立。
重點是買家有能力支付，不等於一定是全市場最低價。 本句談家庭／社群／小企業能否實際承擔一項服務或資源的整體費用，因此焦點是 cost burden；若用 retail-oriented price 或促銷詞，會改變語義重心。 因此在這一句裡不如 affordable cost 精確。
範圍比 price 廣，可包含製造、營運、取得服務或總體費用。 本句談家庭／社群／小企業能否實際承擔一項服務或資源的整體費用，因此焦點是 cost burden；若用 retail-oriented price 或促銷詞，會改變語義重心。 因此在這一句裡不如 affordable cost 精確。

words.meaning: 很有競爭力的低價；吸引人的價格
words.note: British English 商業用語，表示價格壓得很有吸引力、具競爭力。比 competitive price 更帶銷售／報價語氣。

falseSynonyms.zh: cheap 可表示價格低，但也可能暗示品質差；low price 本身只描述價格水平。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The shop sells the bags at a low price. The bag looks cheap and poorly made.

falseSynonyms.zh: discounted price 一定暗示相對原價有折扣；low price 不需要有原價作比較。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The item is available at a discounted price this week. The brand keeps its prices low all year.

falseSynonyms.zh: affordable 是『目標買家負擔得起』，不一定客觀上非常低。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The flats are offered at affordable prices for local families. The factory keeps unit prices low through automation.

falseSynonyms.zh: sale price 是促銷／特賣期間的價格；低價商品平日也可以一直維持 low price。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The sale price is £25 until Sunday. The store is known for consistently low prices.

falseSynonyms.zh: competitive price 是相對競爭者有吸引力，不保證是市場最低價。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The firm submitted a competitive price. The basic model has a genuinely low price.

falseSynonyms.zh: price 是買方支付的售價；cost 可包括生產、使用、維修或取得服務的整體成本。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The retail price is low. The system is cheap to operate because its running cost is low.

falseSynonyms.zh: bargain price 帶『非常划算』的評價；low price 可只是客觀描述。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We found the chair at a bargain price. The company targets the low-price segment.

falseSynonyms.zh: price 是某商品／服務的具體價格；pricing 是制定價格的制度、策略或整體做法。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The price is £40. The company changed its pricing strategy.
